_doc: The combined testimonial set used on the dedicated Reviews page. The per-page files (reviews.json, reviews_events.json, reviews_franchise.json, reviews_order.json) stay as they are and keep serving their own pages - this one is the full wall, so the Reviews page shows everything in one place.
title: What people say afterwards
sub: Counter regulars, event bookers, wholesale buyers and franchise partners.

items.name: Ramesh P.
items.text: The most refreshing thing I have had all summer, and I have tried every stall on this road. You can taste that it was cut this morning.

items.name: Anjali S.
items.text: The standing order has become the best part of Thursday. It turns up cold, every week, without me having to think about it once.

items.name: Vikram N.
items.text: They set up in the corner of the garden and there was a queue for four hours straight. Half the speeches were about the juice.

items.name: Priya D.
items.text: We have used three suppliers before this one. This is the first where the delivery day has never moved and nothing has ever arrived warm.

items.name: Tom H.
items.text: The training was three weeks and none of it was padding. I opened knowing how to run the press, cost a crate and read a bad stalk.

items.name: Sunita R.
items.text: Turned up when they said, set up in two hours, cleared in one, and left the pitch cleaner than they found it. Booked again for next year.

items.name: Daniel O.
items.text: We wanted something that was not another coffee cart. Everyone remembered it, which is the whole point of doing these things.

items.name: Meera K.
items.text: My grandfather had it from a cart exactly like this. It tastes the same. I did not expect to be quite so pleased about that.

items.name: James F.
items.text: The allergen paperwork arrived before I had to ask for it. That tells you most of what you need to know about how they run things.
